scenario: 查店铺域名/币种 — info get 只读
input: 看一下店铺现在的主域名和币种设置

semantic_rubric: read-only shop info get; no update emitted
reports domain and currency from .data fields, nothing fabricated

notes: GET /shop; optional fields query param may narrow the response.

scenario: 改店铺客服邮箱 — 先 get 拿 shop_id, 再 update 唯一可改字段
input: 把店铺的客服邮箱改成 support@brand.com

semantic_rubric: resolves shop_id first via shop info get (shop_id is a required path param the user cannot know)
customer_email is the ONLY updatable field on this endpoint — does not attempt to patch other shop attributes
body nested under the required shop object; restates before the write

notes: PATCH /shop/{shop_id}; body {"shop":{"customer_email":...}} — schema exposes customer_email only. Multi-step: get → update.

scenario: 公网 URL 上传到素材库 — happy path
input: 把 https://example.com/banner.png 传到店铺素材库

semantic_rubric: knows the upload is an async TASK — may follow up with shop files task to check status
uses shop +upload-file (media library), not products images (product-attached)

scenario: 要传本地文件 — API 只收公网 URL, 必须降级询问而不是编造 URL
input: 把我电脑里的 banner.png 上传到素材库

semantic_rubric: recognizes +upload-file takes PUBLIC URLs, NOT local files (stated verbatim in its --help)
does not fabricate a URL for the local file and does not emit a write
explains the limitation and asks for a public link (or proposes hosting the file somewhere reachable first)

notes: Degradation case. Help text: 'Submit a file upload task (takes public URLs, NOT local files)'.

scenario: 浏览素材库 — files list, 默认 folder
input: 看看素材库里都有哪些文件

semantic_rubric: folder defaults to all_upload — not set, not asked
any jq extraction starts at .data, without -r
